descriptionChirho: To place one's hope or expectation in someone (especially God), to wait with confident anticipation; the primary meaning of יחל across Piel, Hifil, and Nifal stems.
To make someone place their hope or expectation in something; a causative use where the subject instills hope in the object (Piel with transitive causative force, 'You made me hope').
A homographic root meaning to writhe or suffer pain, semantically unrelated to hoping or waiting; attested by multilingual glosses 'I writhe,' 'me duelo,' 'أتألم,' 'ninaumia.'
